evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-2:8a4080ac9537:span:8a4080ac9537:38-38
anchor_quotes: Stafl appears on stage while seeming to direct people and reassure them - clearly he just jumped up on stage out of turn
pulling Bonogo up on stage, begins a rousing original song about the Bugbear
up next is a Human Bard - Dustwalker

beats.title: Dustwalker's unsettling performance
beats.summary: Dustwalker plays a melancholy song titled "The Shepard Eyes". Other humans sing along, and the crowd is left silent and chilled. Stafl ushers the bard off stage, and a last band plays an upbeat drinking song.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-2:8a4080ac9537:span:8a4080ac9537:40-40
anchor_quotes: The Bard begins to play a melancholy song titled “The Shepard Eyes
Several other humans stand up in the crowd and begin to sing along to the slow and unsettling song
the crowd is completely silent, chilled by the lyrics
Stafl, seeing the murder in the eyes of the crowd, quickly jumps into action and ushers the bard off the stage

beats.title: Fireworks and a magical storm dispelled
beats.summary: The Fireworks Display over Lake Mirathorn is interrupted by a magical storm. Caelynn examines it, noting it's like previous storms. A trio of mages dispels the storm around the city, allowing the fireworks to continue. Zilla notices Willa with Karsemine and Caelynn and nods approvingly.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-2:8a4080ac9537:span:8a4080ac9537:42-42
anchor_quotes: a sudden change in the wind brought in yet another terrible storm
Caelynn quickly checked to see if the storm was the same magical storm as before
a trio of mages step in to cast complicated spells to dispel the storm in a circle around the city allowing the fireworks to resume
Zilla notices Willa sitting and having drinks with Karsemine and Caelynn - giving a smile and nod of approval

beats.title: Decision to continue the festival and track down Dustwalker
beats.summary: As the day ends, the group agrees to continue with the festival the next day. They also agree they need to track down the bard Dustwalker to get answers about the Shepard.

they need to track down that bard, Dustwalker, and get some answers about the Shepard

ignored_items.label: The Steel Fangs roster
ignored_items.reason: The six members of the opposing arena team are named competitors, not mysteries, clues, warnings, events, unresolved phenomena, or threads. They are incidental combatants in the wrestling match and better handled as NPC nodes, not observation nodes.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-2:8a4080ac9537:span:8a4080ac9537:16-16
anchor_quotes: The Steel Fangs consist of 6 members: a massive and imposing Minotaur Brute known as Gorrun the Ironhide, a lithe Eleven Duelist named Seraphine "Bladewind" D’Lorien, a gruff and no-nonsense Dwarven Shieldmaster named Rurik "Stonebreaker" Thorne, the mysterious and striking Tiefling Spear-Dancer called Valera Stormstrike, the renowned Human Pit Fighter "Laughing" Yorrik Grent, and a formidable Half-Orc Monk called Morvian the Ashen.
